name: wrapped
description: Your year in code, as a Spotify-Wrapped-style video, rendered locally with HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Your year in code, as a shareable recap video.
interface.longDescription: Reads your local git history and, if you allow it, your AI-coding sessions, finds the story of your year, and renders a vertical Wrapped-style video with music, a share card and share copy. Runs fully locally.
defaultPrompt: Make my year in code wrapped.
Wrap up my coding year as a video.
